title.zh: Trump administration is suspending Microsoft from a green card program
title.en: Trump administration is suspending Microsoft from a green card program

current_state.zh: The Trump administration suspended Microsoft from a green card sponsorship program as part of a wider crackdown on H-1B and PERM visa practices, sparking a large debate over enforcement fairness and tech-labor abuse.
